##### Project general facts

Tria is a contemporary residential development featuring a distinctive three-wing architectural design and offering a collection of apartments, podium townhouses, and penthouses. The project is designed with a focus on modern living, incorporating flexible layouts, spacious interiors, and contemporary architectural aesthetics. Residences are planned to maximize natural ventilation and airflow, while large windows enhance natural light throughout the living spaces. The development also promotes environmentally conscious design principles through the integration of eco-living solutions and efficient residential planning.

Residents have access to a variety of lifestyle amenities designed for relaxation, recreation, and social interaction. The development features a rooftop infinity swimming pool, dedicated social spaces, landscaped gardens, manicured lawns, and open terrace areas available for residents and guests. These amenities create a balanced living environment that supports both leisure and community engagement.

The residences feature premium finishes and contemporary minimalist interiors designed to emphasize comfort, quality, and functionality. Spacious layouts are complemented by expansive windows, while penthouse residences include acoustic glazing glass windows for enhanced comfort. Kitchens come fully equipped with appliances. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects modern finishing with high-quality materials and carefully considered architectural detailing.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a dynamic and fully integrated community that seamlessly blends residential, commercial, and technological innovation. Strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, it provides easy access to key areas in Dubai, including Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport. As one of Dubai's most prominent free zones, it serves as a hub for technology-driven businesses, startups, and multinational corporations.

Designed as a self-sufficient smart city, Dubai Silicon Oasis offers a balanced lifestyle with beautifully landscaped residential neighborhoods, high-tech commercial spaces, and state-of-the-art infrastructure. The area is home to various residential options, including modern apartments, townhouses, and family-friendly villas, making it an attractive destination for professionals and families alike.

Residents and visitors benefit from a comprehensive range of amenities, including reputable schools, healthcare centers, shopping destinations, and recreational facilities. Parks, sports complexes, and fitness centers contribute to an active and healthy lifestyle. Dubai Silicon Oasis stands out for its innovation-driven ethos and forward-thinking urban design, positioning it as a leading destination for living, working, and technological advancement.
